definitions.explanation: Fish with white or pale-colored flesh, as opposed to red-fleshed fish. Includes species like sea bream ({鯛|たい}), flounder (ヒラメ), and cod (タラ). The category is based on the color of the raw flesh.

examples.japanese: {白身魚|しろみざかな}のフライが{好|す}きだ。
{離乳食|りにゅうしょく}には{白身魚|しろみざかな}がおすすめだ。
examples.english: White fish is recommended for baby food.

examples.japanese: {白身魚|しろみざかな}は{淡泊|たんぱく}な{味|あじ}わいで、どんな{料理法|りょうりほう}にも{合|あ}う。
examples.english: White fish has a light, delicate flavor and suits any cooking method.

notes:
A culinary and everyday term for fish whose flesh is white or pale when raw. This is a fundamental category in Japanese food culture, used at sushi bars, in recipes, and in nutritional advice.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- {鯛|たい}: sea bream
- {鱈|たら}: cod
- {鰈|かれい}: flounder
- {鱸|すずき}: sea bass

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白身魚|しろみざかな}のフライ: fried white fish
- {白身魚|しろみざかな}の{刺身|さしみ}: white fish sashimi
- {白身魚|しろみざかな}の{煮付|につ}け: simmered white fish

RELATED WORDS:
- {赤身魚|あかみざかな}: red-fleshed fish (tuna, bonito, etc.)
- {青魚|あおざかな}: blue-backed fish (mackerel, sardines, etc.)
- {白身|しろみ}: white flesh; also means egg white
